limitations: A 416-cell 6-mile saved map is slower to first full drawing by about 169 ms in the exact-run warm median. Each scenario is same-run base/head, not comparable as a speed claim across different runners.
Cold payload for the 416-cell artwork case is 3,266,247 bytes versus 126,294; the measured 6-mile warm pan/zoom frame medians remained about 16.7 ms.
R03 guard is on the repository's production, Check and GitHub Pages build entrypoints. An ad-hoc invocation bypassing package scripts is outside the verified deployment path.
PNG/JSON current fixtures and two map scales are covered. Separate player visibility, separate SVG export format and full cross-system corpus breadth are outside current score evidence.
